reply_text:
I've saved your correction, Ilse: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 10 June, and the date in this morning's #north-team post was wrong. I also confirmed it in a reply to your message here.

My notes only show up in this channel, so I won't see this correction in #north-team. And your post there hasn't changed, so anyone reading it will still see the wrong date. Since you said no action was needed, I left it alone. If you want people there to know, you could edit the post or add a short follow-up.
